recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Iron is chemical element 26, and no enzyme can build an element out of anything else, so every iron atom in haemoglobin arrived in food, water or a pill. Recycling only reuses atoms already present, so once losses outrun absorption the sole remedy is dietary iron, which means iron supplements are never redundant on this axis and stand or fall entirely on measured status and losses. recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Iodine is chemical element 53, so there is no synthetic route to it and thyroid hormone output falls when dietary supply stops. What the body does make is the hormone itself: thyroid peroxidase attaches dietary iodide to tyrosine residues on thyroglobulin to build T4 and T3, and deiodinases salvage iodide when hormone is degraded. The enzymatic machinery is endogenous while every iodine atom is dietary, so iodine supplementation is genuinely useful wherever intake is low and pointless once intake is adequate.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Magnesium is chemical element 12 and cannot be synthesised, so all of the roughly 25 g in an adult body came from food. Bone holds 50 to 60% of it and the kidney adjusts reabsorption tightly, which buffers short-term intake gaps and is also why serum magnesium is a poor guide to total body stores. With synthesis at zero, the only question is whether habitual intake, drug use or renal and gastrointestinal losses justify supplementing, and for a large share of the population intake alone does.

recovered_entries.supplement: Omega-3 EPA and DHA (fish and algal oil)
recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Humans cannot make the parent omega-3, alpha-linolenic acid, at all, and the conversion of dietary ALA to the functional long-chain forms runs into a hard ceiling: roughly 5 to 8 percent to EPA and under 0.5 to 4 percent to DHA, higher in women than in men. The pathway is present and rate-limited at FADS2, and it competes with the much larger linoleic acid flux for the same desaturase, so a high omega-6 intake lowers the yield further. That combination, a required precursor plus a capped conversion, is what makes preformed EPA and DHA a coherent supplement rather than a duplicate of your own synthesis.

recovered_entries.endogenous_note: Four labels are used, and adequate quantity is judged against basal physiological function at the tissue's normal set point, not against a storage ceiling and not against the dose a trial happened to use. FULL: the human pathway is complete and output covers basal need in health. PARTIAL: the pathway exists but output is structurally capped below what the relevant pool or function needs, so dietary supply routinely contributes. recovered_entries.still_matters_when: Use the axis to decide whether a product has a target, then use pharmacology and trial evidence to decide whether it works. The axis can kill a premise (glucosamine, collagen as a molecule, test boosters) and it can support one (creatine, beta-alanine, vitamin C at low intake, B12 in a vegan). It never settles efficacy on its own.
